## 50190b6e8882

**Reproduced defect — advertised override axes are silent no-ops.**

Audited generator SHA-256: `35c51aebc6080393972f208f79277e154b400bf66b5fde329a1a55f2040f7fac`.

The generator advertises `palette_kind` values `default`, `warm`, `cool`, and `varied`, and advertises the same four values as helpful `texture` controls. The targeted probe held seed, sample index, and difficulty fixed while changing each value. Across 40 draws:

- every `palette_kind` value was byte-identical to the default on 40/40 draws;
- every helpful `texture` value was byte-identical to the default on 40/40 draws;
- all generated grids passed `self_check`;
- source inspection confirms neither keyed draw is consumed by generation.

This is an actionable metadata/override defect: callers and the override checker are told these axes change the sample, but they do not. Suggested repair is to either implement observable keyed behavior for every advertised value or remove the axes/helpful-value declarations.

Reproducer and report:

- `checks/audit/50190b6e8882/probe.py`
- `checks/audit/50190b6e8882/report.json`

No source was changed for this audit target.
